definitions.explanation: A large natural elevation of the earth's surface.
A large amount of something stacked up.
The most intense or crucial point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧{山|やま}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Mt. Fuji is the highest mountain in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{山|やま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I camped in the mountains in summer.

⟦{遠|とお}く→遠く：01680_tooku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{山|やま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えます→見える：01165_mieru⟧。

There's a pile of books on the desk.

⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{山|やま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なっていた→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}した→掃除：02889_souji⟧。

examples.english: I got past the busiest period at work, so things got a little easier.
The climax of the movie is the last 30 minutes.

notes:
{山|やま} is one of the most fundamental Japanese words, with meanings extending well beyond the physical sense of 'mountain.'

FUNCTIONS:
1. Physical mountain or hill
2. A large pile or heap of things (figurative)
3. The climax, peak, or critical point of a situation

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {山|やま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧: to make a guess, to speculate
- {山|やま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}える→越える：02099_koeru⟧: to get over the worst/critical point
- {山|やま}⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧: a huge amount of, mountains of
- {山|やま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to reach the climax (of a story)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧: Mt. Fuji
- ⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧: volcano
- ⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧: mountain climbing
- ⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧: mountain path
- ⟦{山|やま}{小屋|ごや}→山小屋：18402_yamagoya⟧: mountain hut

NOTE: Mountain names use {山|さん} or {山|ざん} in on'yomi readings: ⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧, ⟦{高野山|こうやさん}→高野山：noentry⟧.
